final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry's first line to extract the timestamp, service, level, and message. I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format. I included only entries with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case-insensitive). For each entry, I counted the repeat occurrences from the following lines with the pattern "-- last message repeated N times --" and added that to the repeat_count. I collected all such entries and summed the repeat_count per service for counts_by_service. The result was written to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
